about_the_game:
The Last Village is a third-person, single-player Viking survival RPG where you must defend the last Norse settlement against rising waves of undead horrors. Explore by day, survive by night, and uncover the dark mystery behind a cursed portal that's unleashing chaos upon your homeland.

Key Features

  • Real-Time Melee Combat
    Equip swords, axes, and daggers to attack, block, and dodge in fast-paced, skill-based battles. Critical hits and combo moves can turn the tide.

  • Village Defense System
    Recruit and command NPC warriors. Assign archers to towers and melee fighters to gates. Use the War Table to plan your defense.

  • Story-Driven Quest System
    Unravel the mystery of the Draughts and the cursed portal through quests and narrative-driven interactions with villagers.

  • Inventory & Crafting
    Buy, collect, and equip powerful items. Heal with food, enhance combat with gear, and manage what you carry in a functional inventory UI.

Can You Save the Last Village?

The attacks will never stop. The nights will grow darker. Only the strong and the clever will survive long enough to destroy the portal and save what’s left of your people.

content_descriptors.notes: The Last Village contains fantasy violence, primarily in the form of zombies that players fight and kill using melee weapons like swords. There is blood and combat, but no sexual content, sexual assault, or self-harm. There are no drugs or alcohol use depicted in the game. Players sensitive to depictions of violence should be aware before purchasing.
